names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 29 iunie, «Sfinții Apostoli Petru și Pavel».
Read out of saint.gr's line for 29 Ιουνίου, «Άγιοι Πέτρος και Παύλος Πρωτοκορυφαίοι Απόστολοι», with the rank words left off.

Read out of the Ohrid Prologue’s second heading for the Julian 29 June, „Свети апостол Павле.“ — Свети is not a rank and апостол is, so §6 leaves the bare forename; the heading gives no city and no by-name, and Тарс and племе Венијаминово are both in the body. It folds with six other folders, one of which was added to the corpus the same day, and the fold is in this commit’s FINDINGS and in `READ_FOLDS`.

feast.note: The same menologion day this folder's Romanian, Greek and Serbian rows already carry, so there is no second day and none is noted. The line is the joint feast of the two, «Славных и всехвальных первоверховных апостолов Петра и Павла (67).», and the day page's two hymns are joint likewise; both are written on both folders. **NO RUSSIAN NAME FORM WAS STORED AND THAT IS DELIBERATE.** The name link gives «Апостол Петр» and «Апостол Павел», and stripping the rank word leaves a bare forename which this corpus already holds many times over — «Петр» alone has eleven holders and «Павел» more — so storing it would widen a fold for no gain, the calendar having given no epithet and no surname to either apostle. Withholding the form is the answer the previous Russian block took three times on 22 июня. **A YEAR IS WRITTEN WHERE THE FOLDER HAD NONE.** The line's «(67)» is the only year any of this folder's four sources has given, and it is recorded as a traditional death year for both apostles with the line quoted; no other calendar here dates them at all. The index of lives this calendar links was NOT read whole — this folder's life is already written out of its other sources — and that is said plainly rather than claimed otherwise.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 29 июня ст. ст. — «Славных и всехвальных первоверховных апостолов Петра и Павла (67).»

attestations.note: The day’s second of two entries, and the row this folder had from no Slavonic book until now. **TWO `related` ROWS WRITTEN, AND THE FIRST OF THEM COMPLETES A ROW THE CORPUS ALREADY HELD ONE WAY.** „Крштен од апостола Ананије, прозват Павлом и увршћен у службу великих апостола.“ — baptised by the apostle Ananias, renamed Paul and numbered in the service of the great apostles. `ananias-the-apostle` is `Bishop of Damascus` and an apostle of the Seventy in this corpus, kept on 1 October by all four calendars — **including this same book, whose 1 October heading that folder already quotes** — so the identification is not off a bare forename. That folder related to this one before today and **this one did not relate back**, and the reason the floor never caught it is measurable: this folder’s own prose off saint.gr already names Ananias unlinked, and the only thing keeping the test quiet is that his display name is the single word `Ananias`, which `usableName` refuses. The row is supplied here and the pair is two-way. **THE SECOND IS THE TEACHER.** „Најпре се звао Савле, учио се код Гамалила, био фарисеј и гонитељ Хришћанства.“ — he was first called Saul, studied under Gamaliel, was a Pharisee and a persecutor of Christianity. `gamaliel-the-teacher-of-the-law` is the righteous teacher of the law of the first century, kept by the Romanian 2 August, and that folder carried **no `related` key at all**. Teacher and disciple is a relation by the Euthymius ruling, so the row is written both ways and is the first that folder has. **NO `dates`, AND THE FOLDER HAD NONE BEFORE.** „Пошто је испунио све дане и ноћи трудом и страдањем за Христа, пошто је организовао цркву по многобројним местима, и пошто је достигао ту меру савршенства, да је могао рећи: „Не живим ја него Христос живи у мени“, тада је био посечен у Риму, у време цара Нерона, кад и апостол Петар.“ puts the beheading at Rome in the time of the emperor Nero and at the same time as the apostle Peter, and that is the whole of the chronology: a reign and a companion, neither of them a year. Nothing is written, which is the reading the Julian 28 June made on Senuphius and the Julian 26 and 27 June before it. No `locations`: Tarsus, Damascus, Arabia, Spain and Rome are named in clauses. `types` untouched at `apostle`, the heading’s own rank word; фарисеј is not a rank in any table and апостол незнабожаца, apostle of the Gentiles, is a by-name and not a grade. **AND THE REACH DISAGREES WITH THE GREEK PAGE WITHOUT CONTRADICTING IT.** „Са пламеном ревношћу проповедао Јеванђеље свуда од граница Арабије до Шпаније, међу Јеврејима и међу незнабошцима.“ has him preach everywhere from the borders of Arabia to Spain, where saint.gr counted four missionary journeys and made him the founder of the Church of Greece. Both are in the life and neither is reconciled. The Prologue prints no troparion and no kontakion: the day carries the verse only, which is Bishop Nikolai’s own and belongs to no person. The ПЕСМА is twenty lines on the pair together and it is in no field and in no life (§3), read before this was written: „Петар прости човек, Павле школовани – Благодаћу Духа оба обасјани.“ sets the unlearned man beside the schooled one, and „Кад им бурног дана стиже бурно вече Нерон крвожедни живот им пресече.“ gives the death to Nero. It names no third person and adds no fact the two entries do not carry.

hymns.text: Cei ce sunteți între Apostoli mai întâi pe scaun șezători și lumii învățători, Stăpânului tuturor rugați-vă, pace lumii să dăruiască și sufletelor noastre mare milă.

source.text: Doxologia — Troparul Sfinților Apostoli Petru și Pavel; the troparion is printed for the two of them together.

english.text: O ye who are first enthroned among the Apostles and teachers of the world, pray to the Master of all that He grant peace to the world and to our souls great mercy.

hymns.text: Οἱ τῶν Ἀποστόλων πρωτόθρονοι, καὶ τῆς Οἰκουμένης διδάσκαλοι, τῷ Δεσπότῃ τῶν ὅλων πρεσβεύσατε, εἰρήνην τῆ οἰκουμένῃ δωρήσασθαι, καὶ ταῖς ψυχαῖς ἡμῶν τὸ μέγα ἔλεος.

source.text: saint.gr, Ἀπολυτίκιον, Ἦχος δ’, on the page of «Άγιοι Πέτρος και Παύλος Πρωτοκορυφαίοι Απόστολοι»

english.text: First-enthroned of the Apostles and teachers of the whole world, intercede with the Master of all things that He grant peace to the world and great mercy to our souls.

hymns.text: Τοὺς ἀσφαλεῖς καὶ θεοφθόγγους κήρυκας, τὴν κορυφὴν τῶν Μαθητῶν σου Κύριε, προσελάβου εἰς ἀπόλαυσιν, τῶν ἀγαθῶν σου καὶ ἀνάπαυσιν, τοὺς πόνους γὰρ ἐκείνων καὶ τὸν θάνατον, ἐδέξω ὑπὲρ πᾶσαν ὁλοκάρπωσιν, ὁ μόνος γινώσκων τὰ ἐγκάρδια.

source.text: saint.gr, Κοντάκιον, Ἦχος β’, Τοὺς ἀσφαλεῖς, on the page of «Άγιοι Πέτρος και Παύλος Πρωτοκορυφαίοι Απόστολοι»

english.text: The sure and God-inspired heralds, the chief of Thy disciples, Thou hast taken to Thyself, O Lord, into the enjoyment of Thy good things and into rest; for Thou didst accept their labours and their death above every whole burnt offering, O Thou who alone knowest the secrets of the heart.

hymns.text: Апостолов первопрестольницы/ и вселенныя учителие,/ Владыку всех молите/ мир вселенней даровати// и душам нашим велию милость.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 29 июня ст. ст. — «Тропарь апостолов», глас 4. Joint to the two apostles, as the day is: the title names neither and the text addresses the pair. This folder already holds the Greek and the Romanian copies of the same two hymns, and the English here is the rendering those already carry, the Slavonic saying what they say.

english.text: First-enthroned of the Apostles and teachers of the whole world, intercede with the Master of all things that He grant peace to the world and great mercy to our souls.

hymns.text: Твердыя и боговещанныя проповедатели,/ верх апостолов Твоих, Господи,/ приял еси в наслаждение благих Твоих и покой:/ болезни бо онех и смерть приял еси паче всякаго всеплодия,// Едине, сведый сердечная.

death.note: The folder held no date of any kind until today and none of its other three calendars gives one. days.pravoslavie.ru prints the year in the joint line for 29 июня ст. ст.: «Славных и всехвальных первоверховных апостолов Петра и Павла (67).». It is the year of the joint feast of the two apostles and is recorded as traditional for both.
